info.name: Marketplace API
info.description: Complete API collection for On-Demand Home Services Marketplace with 31 endpoints across 2 microservices

request.description: Register a new user. role can be: CUSTOMER, SERVICE_PROVIDER, ADMIN
Login and get JWT token. Copy the token for use in other requests.
Get user details by user ID
Update user profile information
Delete user account

item.name: Wallet Management
item.description: All wallet endpoints use the authenticated user's ID from the JWT token. No userId needed in request body.

request.description: Get wallet balance of the currently logged-in user. userId taken from JWT.
Add funds to the logged-in user's own wallet. userId taken from JWT - cannot add to another user's wallet.
Deduct amount from the logged-in user's wallet for a booking. userId taken from JWT.
Refund amount to the logged-in user's wallet. userId taken from JWT.
Check if the logged-in user has sufficient balance. Returns true/false. userId taken from JWT.
Get wallet balance for a specific user by ID. ADMIN ONLY. Replace 1 with actual userId.

item.name: Admin Management
item.description: Admin-only endpoints. Register a user with role=ADMIN, login, then use that JWT token here.

request.description: View all registered users in the system. ADMIN ONLY.
View all wallet transactions (DEBIT/CREDIT) across all users. ADMIN ONLY.
View all booking-related deductions and refunds. ADMIN ONLY.
View all wallet transactions for a specific user. Replace 1 with actual userId. ADMIN ONLY.
View all compensation log entries for a specific user. Replace 1 with actual userId. ADMIN ONLY.

Create a new service category (Admin only)
Required: ROLE_ADMIN
Status: 201 Created

Retrieve all service categories
Required: ROLE_ADMIN
Status: 200 OK

Retrieve a specific category by ID
Required: ROLE_ADMIN
Status: 200 OK
Error: 404 Not Found

Update an existing category
Required: ROLE_ADMIN
Status: 200 OK
Error: 404 Not Found, 409 Conflict (duplicate name)

Delete a category (soft delete)
Required: ROLE_ADMIN
Status: 204 No Content
Error: 404 Not Found

request.description:
Update an existing service offer
Required: ROLE_SERVICE_PROVIDER
Provider must own the offer
Status: 200 OK
Error: 404 Not Found, 403 Forbidden (not owner)

Deactivate a service offer (soft delete - sets status to INACTIVE)
Required: ROLE_SERVICE_PROVIDER
Provider must own the offer
Status: 204 No Content
Error: 404 Not Found, 403 Forbidden (not owner)

Toggle offer status between ACTIVE and INACTIVE
Required: ROLE_SERVICE_PROVIDER
Provider must own the offer
Status: 200 OK with updated offer
Error: 404 Not Found, 403 Forbidden (not owner)

Browse all active services
Required: Authenticated user (any role)
Filters: status = ACTIVE, availableFrom >= NOW()
Status: 200 OK

Browse services by category
Required: Authenticated user (any role)
Filters: category_id = categoryId, status = ACTIVE, availableFrom >= NOW()
Status: 200 OK
Error: 404 Not Found (category doesn't exist)

Search services by keyword and/or price range
Required: Authenticated user (any role)
Query Parameters (all optional):
- keyword: Search in title and description
- categoryId: Filter by category
- minPrice: Minimum price filter
- maxPrice: Maximum price filter
Filters: status = ACTIVE, availableFrom >= NOW()
Status: 200 OK

Get detailed information about a specific service
Required: Authenticated user (any role)
Validation: Offer must be ACTIVE
Status: 200 OK
Error: 404 Not Found (offer not found or inactive)

Check availability window and current availability status of a service
Required: Authenticated user (any role)
Returns: availableFrom, availableTo, status, isAvailable
Status: 200 OK
Error: 404 Not Found

item.name: Booking
item.description:
Booking Service endpoints (Jakarta EE / EJB on WildFly port 8080).
Base URL: http://localhost:8080/booking-service-1.0-SNAPSHOT/api
All endpoints require a JWT token in the Authorization header.
customerId is extracted from the JWT — never sent in the body.

request.description:
Create a new booking.
customerId is extracted from the JWT token automatically.
Flow: Validates offer → checks wallet → deducts payment → saves booking → publishes RabbitMQ event.
Status: 201 Created (CONFIRMED) or 400 Bad Request (insufficient balance)
idempotencyKey is optional — prevents duplicate bookings on retry.

Get a single booking by its ID.
Replace 1 with the actual booking ID.
Status: 200 OK
Error: 404 Not Found

Get all bookings made by a specific customer.
Replace 1 with the actual customerId.
Returns booking history ordered by createdAt DESC.
Status: 200 OK

Get all bookings assigned to a specific service provider.
Replace 1 with the actual providerId.
Returns completed and upcoming services with customer info.
Status: 200 OK

Get all bookings in the system (admin use).
Returns all records ordered by createdAt DESC.
Status: 200 OK

Cancel a confirmed booking.
Replace 1 with the actual bookingId.
Only the customer who made the booking can cancel it (verified via JWT).
Only CONFIRMED bookings can be cancelled.
Flow: Refunds wallet → updates status to CANCELLED → publishes RabbitMQ event.
Status: 200 OK
Error: 404 Not Found, 400 Bad Request (wrong customer), 409 Conflict (not CONFIRMED)
